text:
The final shadow may close my eyes and carry off the white day, and an hour flattering its anxious yearning may unbind this soul of mine;

but on the farther shore memory will not leave where it burned: my flame knows how to swim cold water and lose respect for stern law.

Soul whom a whole god imprisoned, veins that gave fluid to so much fire, marrow that has gloriously burned:

they will leave their body, not their care; they will be ashes, yet will feel; they will be dust, yet dust in love.

translation.title: Constant Love Beyond Death
